reconciliation_notes.net_income: Official FY2025 provisional net profit (KRW 48.5bn) and vendor-attributed net income differ by definition; TTM valuation lenses use the normalized vendor series while the official figure remains preserved as Tier-A evidence.
reconciliation_notes.working_capital: TTM FCF is not extrapolated because the latest period contains KRW 64.217bn of working-capital cash use. Forecast Delta-NWC is rebuilt from explicit NWC/sales paths.
reconciliation_notes.capex: Historical capex is unusually light. Scenario capex ratios are deliberately raised above the trailing level to avoid treating growth as free.
reconciliation_notes.minority_interest: Latest directly retrievable minority interest is KRW 19.036bn at 2026-Q1; scenario bridge rounds future minority claim to KRW 20bn rather than silently omitting it.
reconciliation_notes.wacc: WACC is constructed from sourced risk-free, beta and country-risk evidence plus an explicit normalized debt-cost assumption.
